name: LEAG
note: Shirt sponsor of Energie Cottbus since 2023-24. The ownership claim only establishes Lausitz Energie Bergbau AG as a public limited company (AG). According to leag.de (https://www.leag.de/de/unternehmen/, opened 2026-10-01), Lausitz Energie Verwaltungs GmbH is the joint sub-holding company and majority owner of Lausitz Energie Bergbau AG, and the LEAG group is part of the internationally active EP Group (epgroup.eu). EP Group’s owners have not been sourced from a primary document; until the holder of the controlling stake is identified in the claims, the sponsor stays unrated.
